scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's still one gallery we haven't tried. Let's pack the paintings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's in the rejection pile?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing that helps us pack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did the biggest gallery say no?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The small one hasn't answered. Let's leave it something to say yes to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's pack your paintings for the last gallery. You've finally picked up a brush again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If the big gallery rejected me too, I'm done. Did they write?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Their letter can wait. This gallery still needs your best three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Pick them, then. I can't face another envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the envelopes. You finish the blue one; there's still somewhere for it to go.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 hides rejection information, but A1–A5 never establish that B needs hope to continue.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 evades B2's rejection pile; A5 redirects B4's biggest-gallery question toward the unanswered application.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 seek facts, but B's personal investment in continuing remains unspecified.

heightening.evidence: A5 repeats A1's packing proposal with a hopeful justification rather than increasing the concealment's consequence.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies paintings and a remaining gallery; B2 makes the rejection pile playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Nothing that helps us pack' economically converts an information request into practical evasion.

cardFidelity.evidence: B2 threatens to quit; A3 postpones the letter and A5 takes control of envelopes, although the rejection remains implied.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 redirects B2 toward three paintings; A5 answers B4's envelope aversion with a division of work.

relationship.evidence: B4 entrusts selection to A, making A a practical supporter with increasing control over information.

heightening.evidence: A3 delays one letter; after B4, A5 assumes responsibility for all envelopes and assigns continued painting.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes gallery submissions and resumed painting; A5 supplies the unfinished blue painting.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'somewhere for it to go' sustains hope economically, with restrained rather than conspicuous wit.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 links a rejection to quitting; A3 withholds discussion of the letter and redirects effort.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 cannot face envelopes and delegates selection; A5 takes over correspondence and gives B a painting task.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A3 and A5 protect continued work by controlling potentially discouraging information.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 expands a temporary deflection into ongoing management of the envelopes.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D111 makes A conceal discouraging facts because A believes preserving B's hope is necessary for B to continue.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary encouragement can acknowledge all the bad news; this drive requires protective withholding.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A3 withholds the pile's contents; revised B2 explicitly links rejection to quitting, and A3 withholds the letter.

records.recommendedEdit: The revision preserves the gallery setting and supplies the missing dependence on hope. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (B2/A3 concealment protects continued painting), logic 5 (A3 answers the letter threat; A5 accepts B4's envelope request), relationship 4 (B4 delegates a painful task), heightening 4 (A5 assumes future correspondence), specificity 4 (A1 paintings, A5 blue canvas), brevity/wit 4 (A3's useful evasion); total 90.
records.remainingConcern: The letter's discouraging contents are inferred rather than established. No rewrite needed for an internal pass; reviewed the supplied original.
records.writerReservation: A's protective motive is clear, but withholding another artist's correspondence can feel controlling; performance should preserve sincere concern.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike D111-single-b's sacrifice of living space, this alternative protects hope through administrative shielding.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The garden plot might still be available. Keep the seed packets.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered half the letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The useful half is here: waiting list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How long is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Long enough for us to practise keeping seedlings alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the seed packets. The allotment letter says we're on the waiting list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered our number. If it's another year indoors, I'm giving up gardening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The important bit is we're on it. Let's start tomatoes on my windowsill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll get tired of them before we get a plot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my sunny room. I'll move the bed; keep the packets.

cardFidelity.evidence: B2 exposes concealment and A3 selectively reads the letter, but B's ability to continue is not at stake.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 explains the covered letter after B2; A5 evades B4's question about waiting-list length.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 investigate A's evasion without revealing why the garden matters personally.

heightening.evidence: A5 substitutes seedling practice for an answer, but adds little consequence to A3's selective disclosure.

specificity.evidence: A1's seed packets and B2's partly covered letter provide immediately playable objects.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'useful half' efficiently reveals A's selective definition of useful information.

cardFidelity.evidence: B2 identifies the concealed queue number and threatens to quit; A3 maintains concealment while preserving gardening.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 offers windowsill tomatoes after B2; A5 answers B4's doubt about lasting hospitality with permanent space.

relationship.evidence: B4 questions A's endurance, forcing A to offer a more costly and credible commitment.

heightening.evidence: A3 offers a windowsill; A5 offers the sunny room and relocation of the bed.

specificity.evidence: A1's seed packets and B2's covered queue number establish an immediately playable allotment disappointment.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's bed-moving promise earns its excess through B4's doubt, though the closing packet reminder repeats A1.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 exposes concealment and threatens abandonment; A3 avoids the number and proposes tomatoes.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 doubts A will tolerate the plants; A5 commits the sunny room and moves personal furniture.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A hides the queue position because B's hope determines whether gardening continues.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The hopeful substitute becomes a substantial personal sacrifice while the discouraging number stays concealed.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D111 makes A conceal discouraging facts because A believes preserving B's hope is necessary for B to continue.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Optimistic reframing changes the meaning of known facts; A instead prevents B from learning the discouraging number.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: B2 identifies both the hidden number and the intention to quit, while A3 continues withholding it.

records.recommendedEdit: The allotment setting remains; the revision adds an explicit quitting threshold and a practical sacrifice. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (B2/A3 hidden number), logic 5 (A3 supplies indoor gardening; A5 answers B4's endurance concern), relationship 4 (B4 questions A's commitment), heightening 4 (A5 offers the bedroom), specificity 5 (A3 windowsill tomatoes), brevity/wit 4 (A5's bed displacement follows the offer); total 92.
records.remainingConcern: A5 foregrounds practical generosity more than concealment, but the concealed number still motivates it. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 foregrounds help more than concealment, although the withheld queue position remains the reason this substitute is needed.
records.alternativeComparison: D111-single-a manages correspondence; this alternative answers distrust with an escalating material commitment.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Were you disappointed when they cancelled? You looked quiet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking about your quiet first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I was really hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. Then these tissues aren't just precautionary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like your answer before I give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. I told the cashier the birthday candles were seasonal allergies.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 insists B answer first, but A5's tissues only imply A shares B4's hurt.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 resists B2's returned question; A5 changes immediately after B4 admits being hurt.

relationship.evidence: B2 seeks reciprocity before B4 voluntarily supplies the admission A needs.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves from guarded questioning to an implied emotional disclosure after B4.

specificity.evidence: A1's unspecified cancellation leaves the event and relationship indistinct.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'precautionary' tissues economically reveal earlier emotional preparation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 explicitly requires B's answer first; A5 reveals matching distress only after B4 admits crying.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2's reversal by withholding; A5 uses B4's supermarket confession for a matching disclosure.

relationship.evidence: B2 resists being first, then B4 supplies vulnerable detail that changes A's willingness to disclose.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves from guarded questioning to confession, but immediately completes the admission sequence.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a shared birthday dinner cancelled by Mum; B4 locates the distress in a supermarket.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's candles-as-seasonal-allergies excuse connects to the birthday but sounds more constructed than the preceding speech.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 asks A to disclose instead; A3 insists on the original order.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 admits disappointment through crying, satisfying A's condition for revealing the same hurt.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A's disclosure is explicitly conditional on B going first.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 finally risks a personal account after securing B's admission.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D112 makes A obtain another person's admission of distress before exposing the matching feeling in A.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Soliciting sympathy starts with one's own distress; this drive delays that disclosure until B goes first.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A3 explicitly requires B's answer first; revised A5's 'Me too' makes the previously implied shared hurt unmistakable.

records.recommendedEdit: The revision specifies a family cancellation and makes A's matching feeling explicit. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3 delays, A5 shares), logic 5 (A3 answers B2, A5 echoes B4's supermarket crying), relationship 4 (B2 requests reciprocity), heightening 4 (A5 reveals a humiliating cover story), specificity 5 (A1 birthday dinner), brevity/wit 4 (A5's candle excuse exposes concealment); total 92.
records.remainingConcern: The final excuse is conspicuously written, and the heightening is modest. The original still passes without a required rewrite.
records.writerReservation: The cashier excuse is deliberately transparent; delivery must make it A's embarrassed admission rather than a standalone joke.
records.alternativeComparison: D112-single-b uses a complaint draft and workplace solidarity; this uses familial hurt and reciprocal embarrassment.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did their joke bother you, or was that only your face?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why do you want to know?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm checking whether the room felt the same to both of us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It hurt me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good to know. I can unfold my complaint now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did the boss calling us office furniture hurt you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? Are you making a complaint?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's still in drafts. How did you feel?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Invisible. I've worked here twelve years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. Mine says 'unprofessional'; I'm changing that to 'I went home and cried.'

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 seeks B's hurt before A5 reveals a complaint, although complaint and shared hurt are not identical.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2's motive question; A5 treats B4's admission as permission to disclose.

relationship.evidence: B2 is understandably wary, but A1's 'only your face' makes A sound needlessly mocking.

heightening.evidence: A5 announces a complaint without revealing any of its emotional substance.

specificity.evidence: A1 names an unspecified joke, leaving the shared injury and setting vague.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'unfold my complaint' supplies a flourish without establishing a literal document or revealing hurt.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 discusses the draft without revealing feelings; A5 admits crying only after B4 says 'Invisible.'

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2's complaint question; A5 revises that same complaint in response to B4's emotional admission.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to know the purpose of A's inquiry; B4's twelve years gives the insult personal weight.

heightening.evidence: A5 changes a guarded professional complaint into a more personally exposing statement.

specificity.evidence: A1's 'office furniture' insult and A3's unsent complaint establish a concrete workplace encounter.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's replacement of 'unprofessional' with crying reveals the gap between official language and actual hurt.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 asks whether this concerns a complaint; A3 supplies its draft status while renewing the emotional question.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 admits feeling invisible; A5 reciprocates and makes the draft emotionally explicit.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A delays personal vulnerability until B supplies an emotional admission.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The earned disclosure extends into a proposed written admission.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D112 makes A secure a matching emotional admission before risking A's own disclosure.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Recruiting support for a grievance needs agreement; this card specifically needs another person's vulnerable feeling first.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 postpones discussing the complaint to ask about feeling, and B4's 'Invisible' unlocks A5's crying admission.

records.recommendedEdit: The revision introduces a workplace setting and gives the complaint literal and emotional substance. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3/A5 conditional disclosure), logic 5 (A3 uses B2's complaint question; A5 uses B4's invisibility), relationship 4 (B2 questions A's purpose), heightening 4 (A5 replaces formal wording with personal exposure), specificity 5 (A1 office-furniture insult), brevity/wit 4 (A5's edit embodies the shift); total 92.
records.remainingConcern: A5 moves quickly from private disclosure to revising a complaint, but that exposure is intelligible. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 reports an intended disclosure rather than sending the complaint; the scene appropriately leaves that further choice open.
records.alternativeComparison: Compared with D112-single-a's family confession, the draft gives this alternative a consequential object through which vulnerability changes.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That rejection was exactly the lesson our bakery needed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We needed the contract.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now we've learned not to need one contract.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A powerful second lesson about attachment to equipment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That rejection was exactly the lesson our bakery needed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We needed the contract.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now we've learned not to need one contract.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A powerful second lesson about attachment to equipment.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 calls rejection the exact needed lesson; A3 and A5 make financial losses necessary lessons in independence and detachment.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 converts B2's need for the contract into a lesson; A5 specifically converts B4's mixer debt into another.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants income and B4 names the loan, giving the bakery partner a concrete stake against A's philosophy.

heightening.evidence: B4 moves from lost income to endangered equipment, and A5 extends the growth doctrine to that consequence.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a bakery rejection and B4 supplies a mixer loan with clear practical consequences.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'attachment to equipment' earns its absurdity directly from B4's mixer loan.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 calls rejection exactly necessary; A3 and A5 convert lost income and equipment insecurity into lessons.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 reinterprets B2's need for the contract; A5 specifically turns B4's mixer loan into equipment attachment.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants income and B4 raises debt, pushing A's philosophy against shared business consequences.

heightening.evidence: B4 advances from lost opportunity to inability to pay; A5 makes that additional loss another necessary lesson.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a bakery's rejected bid; B4 supplies the concrete mixer loan.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'attachment to equipment' precisely recasts the mixer debt without adding an unrelated gag.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 insists the contract was needed; A3 declares dependence on that contract the lesson.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 names the mixer loan; A5 derives a second lesson specifically about equipment.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A sincerely presents material setbacks as precisely the growth the bakery required.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The philosophy absorbs a more serious financial consequence without changing its method.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D113 makes A describe a particular loss as precisely the experience needed for personal or collective growth.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Finding a silver lining merely identifies a benefit; A claims the damaging experience itself was necessary.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 says 'exactly the lesson' and A5 treats threatened equipment loss as a further necessary lesson.

records.recommendedEdit: Retained unchanged after internal reread: the original ratings remain 5/5/4/4/5/4, total 92. B4's mixer loan supplies the exact object of A5's next lesson, preserving both causal links and the exact drive.
records.remainingConcern: B chiefly supplies increasingly serious objections, although those objections credibly serve the bakery's survival. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A's detachment can sound sarcastic; the actor must sincerely believe the bakery needs these lessons.
records.alternativeComparison: D113-single-b tests A's willingness to bear loss personally; this alternative exposes a shared business to expanding philosophical rationalization.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Breaking the old mug makes room for a truer morning ritual.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I liked that mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what gives this growth depth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want to glue it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're not ready for the cupboard's new chapter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm sorry I broke your graduation mug. Losing it is exactly how we learn to let go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want to glue it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That urge is why we needed this. We've confused a degree with a drinking vessel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give me your graduation mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Losing mine will teach me generosity. We should both drink from jam jars tomorrow.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 frame the mug's loss as growth, but A5 shifts toward judging B's readiness.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's attachment as depth; A5 rejects B4's gluing proposal without developing its particular implications.

relationship.evidence: B2 values the mug and B4 proposes repair, while A's relationship to the breakage remains unclear.

heightening.evidence: A5's cupboard chapter repeats the growth metaphor instead of finding a new lesson in B4's repair.

specificity.evidence: A1's broken mug and B4's glue are simple playable household details.

brevityWit.evidence: A1's 'truer morning ritual' and A5's 'new chapter' lean on generic self-help language.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 treats B's wish to repair the mug as proof the loss was needed; A5 applies necessary growth to A's own loss.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's glue proposal; A5 accepts B4's demand for A's mug and extends the lesson.

relationship.evidence: B4 challenges the fairness of A's philosophy by making A pay, changing who bears the sacrifice.

heightening.evidence: A5 accepts personal loss and proposes both abandon graduation mugs for jam jars.

specificity.evidence: A1 identifies a broken graduation mug; B2 offers repair, giving the actors a clear immediate dispute.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's generosity lesson earns the jam jars, though the final shared arrangement is slightly elaborate.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 wants repair; A3 interprets that attachment as the reason the breakage was necessary.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 demands A's mug; A5 embraces that sacrifice as a lesson in generosity.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A makes both accidental and requested losses into exactly appropriate lessons.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 includes A in the cost and extends the philosophy to a shared future practice.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D113 makes A insist that a specific disappointment is the exact lesson required for growth.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: An excuse for breaking property deflects blame; this drive extends the claimed educational necessity even to A's own loss.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 makes B2's wish to repair evidence of a needed lesson, and A5 accepts B4's demand as A's lesson in generosity.

records.recommendedEdit: The revision specifies A's responsibility and gives B a consequential counteroffer. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3/A5 necessary lessons), logic 5 (repair prompts attachment diagnosis; B4 prompts self-sacrifice), relationship 5 (B4 redirects the cost), heightening 4 (A5 joins the loss), specificity 5 (graduation mugs and jam jars), brevity/wit 4 (A5 applies the doctrine sincerely); total 95.
records.remainingConcern: The jam-jar proposal leaves the requested replacement's use unstated, but remains a playable offer. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The unusually neat reciprocal challenge is illustrative; it should not imply that the actual scene must end with shared jam jars.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike D113-single-a's denial of business consequences, this alternative heightens through sincere acceptance of B's fairness test.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm completely ready for the results. What's that breathing pattern you're doing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Four in, six out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I was about to begin the advanced six.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've copied me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Synchronised. It's one of my readiness techniques.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm ready for our audition results. Why are you breathing like that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Four in, six out. It stops my hands shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Four in, six out. I like to arrive already regulated.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also write down who I'll call if I don't get in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Lend me your pen; my support network deserves advance notice.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims readiness and A3 borrows B2's breathing, but A5 only renames that same borrowing.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's numbers; A5 answers B4's accusation through the word 'Synchronised.'

relationship.evidence: B2 supplies a technique and B4 detects copying, but B has little independent emotional stake.

heightening.evidence: A5 defends A3's existing technique without borrowing anything newly useful from B4.

specificity.evidence: A1's unspecified results and A3's 'advanced six' leave the situation thin.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's substitution of 'Synchronised' for copying neatly preserves A's claimed expertise.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 adopts B2's breathing while claiming prior regulation; A5 borrows B4's support-list strategy as established readiness.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 repeats B2's exact breathing counts; A5 requests a pen for the call-planning method introduced in B4.

relationship.evidence: B2 manages personal shaking and B4 shares another coping practice, credibly helping a fellow audition applicant.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands from bodily regulation to recruiting a support network while maintaining the readiness performance.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes pending audition results; B2's counts and A5's pen are immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'already regulated' and A5's 'advance notice' neatly disguise newly borrowed coping as preparation.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 teaches the counts through personal explanation; A3 immediately appropriates them.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 introduces planning calls after rejection; A5 needs a pen to adopt that plan.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A repeatedly claims preparedness while sourcing its methods from B.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 adds a social contingency plan to the borrowed breathing strategy.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D114 makes A perform complete readiness while covertly adopting the coping methods supplied by others.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary help-seeking admits a need; A appropriates help while presenting it as evidence of existing preparedness.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 repeats B2's breathing counts as an established practice, and A5 appropriates B4's support-list strategy.

records.recommendedEdit: The revision specifies auditions and replaces the copying accusation with another usable coping response. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3/A5 adopt both methods under readiness claims), logic 5 (counts then contact list), relationship 4 (B2/B4 share personal coping), heightening 4 (A5 needs a borrowed pen), specificity 5 (auditions and support list), brevity/wit 4 (A5 disguises need as courtesy); total 92.
records.remainingConcern: B's two responses conveniently provide usable strategies, but both belong to B's own anxiety. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A3's claim of arriving regulated is conspicuous; the copying should feel anxious and sincere rather than knowingly parodic.
records.alternativeComparison: D114-single-b uses a helper's past experience and direct assistance; this alternative uses peer coping and covert imitation.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Water first, obviously. That's how I handle disappointment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said water wouldn't help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not before the right moment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: When was the right moment?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you brought the glass. Very responsive of you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm completely prepared for this rejection email. Why have you brought water?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small sips helped when I lost my job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My approach exactly. Leave the jug; I prefer a thorough preparation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had my sister read the email aloud. Want me to?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I always arrange a reader. Start gently; that's part of my system.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims ownership of water as coping, but A3 and A5 borrow no fresh strategy from B's responses.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 explains B2's contradiction and A5 answers B4's timing question coherently.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 expose inconsistency but offer no new assistance or personal stake within the exchange.

heightening.evidence: A5 reveals the original glass's arrival rather than increasing A's dependence on surrounding coping.

specificity.evidence: A1 names disappointment and water without establishing what happened or where.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Very responsive of you' supplies a status flourish, but the coping game remains static.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 claims B2's small-sip method as 'My approach'; A5 recasts B4's offer to read as A's usual system.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 requests the water B2 explains; A5 accepts B4's reader offer and adds a gentleness condition.

relationship.evidence: B2 shares experience of job loss and B4 offers concrete help, allowing A to accept care without abandoning composure.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves from borrowing water to depending on B to deliver the feared contents.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes an intimidating email and a brought jug; B4 supplies the practical reading arrangement.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'I always arrange a reader' and 'part of my system' compactly expose improvised readiness.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised the rejected candidate's closing reassurance into a further demand for equal risk. The family-lunch setting remains, with A's earlier disclosure now explicitly made to B's mother. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5 (A1 debt and A5 audience equivalence), logic 5 (A3 answers B2's unsolicited-disclosure objection; A5 evaluates B4's particular fear), relationship 4 (B2 contests the obligation and B4 risks jealousy), heightening 4 (A5 raises private disclosure to exposure before the mother), specificity 5 (A1 Sunday and A5 lunch audience), brevity/wit 4 (A5's exact matching follows A's emotional accounting); total 92. cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've written 'take care.' That's how the last goodbye started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's an ordinary sign-off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So was the first separate dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This isn't ending.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why are the familiar warning words arriving in order?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You ended your message with 'take care.' That's how my last breakup started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you had a cold. I meant get better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He wanted me healthy before he left too. Less guilt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring you soup tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we're at the final kindness. Will it be in a container you don't need back?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 treats a sign-off as a repeated breakup warning, but A5 does not specifically incorporate B4's reassurance as new evidence.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2's ordinariness claim by analogy; A5 asserts words arriving in order without establishing that order or using B4's exact wording.

relationship.evidence: B2 explains an ordinary sign-off and B4 directly reassures A that the relationship is continuing.

heightening.evidence: A5 strengthens the prediction into an ordered pattern, but supplies no concrete additional step from B4.

specificity.evidence: A1's 'take care' message and A3's separate dinner give actors recognizable relationship details.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'familiar warning words arriving in order' summarizes the mechanism more than it demonstrates it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 turns concern about recovery into reduced breakup guilt; A5 interprets soup as the final kindness before departure.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's cold explanation, and A5 derives its returnable-container question directly from B4's soup offer.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects the message's meaning and B4 offers a visit, pursuing care through two different reassuring tactics.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns promised physical presence into evidence of final separation and seeks confirmation through the container.

specificity.evidence: A1 quotes the message sign-off; B2 supplies the cold and B4 establishes tonight's soup visit.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's container question makes abandonment logic concrete and earns the final turn from B4's exact offer.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 explains concern about illness; A3 assimilates recovery into the predicted breakup sequence.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers soup tonight; A5 treats the visit as farewell and tests whether the container removes a future connection.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Every reassurance becomes additional evidence for the same feared abandonment.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 progresses from interpreting words to inspecting a promised caring act for signs of finality.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D120 makes A absorb each new emotional detail into evidence that a previously feared ending is becoming inevitable.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General pessimism predicts trouble; this drive maps fresh details onto the recurrence of one specific ending.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 treats B2's health concern as pre-breakup guilt, and A5 interprets B4's soup offer as the final kindness before departure.

records.recommendedEdit: The revision keeps the message trigger and makes each reassurance supply new concrete evidence. Internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3/A5 repeat-breakup readings), logic 5 (cold concern becomes guilt; soup becomes final kindness), relationship 4 (B offers explanation and care), heightening 4 (A5 anticipates no return visit), specificity 5 (cold, soup, returnable container), brevity/wit 4 (container question extends the fear); total 92.
records.remainingConcern: B remains mainly reassuring rather than expressing a separate need, but the changing care tactics sufficiently shape A. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A's certainty is emotionally difficult for B; sincere fear should remain more prominent than clever suspicion.
records.alternativeComparison: D120-single-b labels relationship events as a script; this alternative transforms specific care details into increasingly tangible breakup evidence.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First you cancel lunch, then stop calling, then ask for the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've only cancelled lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're at the early chapter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the reassuring line that usually comes next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First you cancel lunch, then stop calling, then ask for the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've only cancelled lunch. I'm exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what he said before seeing me became another job.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then? I'll book our usual table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He chose a restaurant too. Public enough that I couldn't beg. Book the corner, please.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 predicts a familiar abandonment sequence, A3 treats correction as its early stage, and A5 incorporates reassurance as the expected next line.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's 'only' to locate an early chapter; A5 specifically recasts B4's rescheduled lunch as scripted reassurance.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects the exaggerated sequence and B4 offers a practical repair through tomorrow's lunch.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4's attempt to disprove the feared ending additional confirmation of it.

specificity.evidence: A1's cancelled lunch, stopped calls, and returned key establish recognizable relational stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'early chapter' and A5's expected reassuring line economically turn both objections into support for the same prediction.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 treats exhaustion as repeating a former partner's withdrawal; A5 treats a restaurant invitation as preparation for the same feared breakup.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's exhaustion supplies A3's 'another job' interpretation; B4's restaurant booking supplies A5's theory about public restraint.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects A's projected sequence and B4 offers their usual table, making a credible attempt to maintain contact despite fatigue.

heightening.evidence: B4's repair attempt becomes stronger breakup evidence in A5, which now bargains for a corner to manage the anticipated humiliation.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies lunch, calls and a key; B4's usual table and A5's requested corner make the relationship anxiety immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Book the corner, please' turns catastrophic interpretation into a practical reservation request without leaving the established logic.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 explains the cancellation as exhaustion; A3 incorporates that explanation into the remembered progression toward being a burden.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 proposes a restaurant reconciliation; A5 identifies restaurants with the former breakup and requests a corner within that feared scenario.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A3 and A5 recruit both an explanation and a reassuring offer as evidence for the identical feared ending.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from predicting abandonment to arranging the conditions of its anticipated public delivery, without establishing that the breakup actually occurs.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D120 makes every fresh relational detail confirm the anticipated repetition of a feared ending.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Catastrophizing can leap from one setback to disaster; A additionally treats attempted reassurance as a familiar stage of the same disaster.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 reads B2's exhaustion through a previous partner's withdrawal; A5 turns B4's restaurant booking into another public breakup and requests a less exposed table.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised the rejected script-label ending into a concrete interpretation with a consequential request. Kept the cancelled-lunch setting, adding B's exhaustion and restaurant booking. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5 (A3 and A5 map new details onto a previous abandonment), logic 5 (B2's tiredness becomes relational burden; B4's public lunch becomes a breakup venue), relationship 4 (B2 expresses a need for rest and B4 offers repair), heightening 4 (A5 begins arranging privacy for the feared ending), specificity 5 (A1 key and A5 corner table), brevity/wit 4 (A5's polite booking request follows the fearful interpretation); total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words; hard gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: A5's reference to begging makes the tone painful; the practical corner request must remain sincere to preserve the earned comic turn. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The prior partner's similar behavior is supplied compactly by A, whose interpretation remains unverified. The final request may play painfully rather than broadly comically.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved alternative interprets soup as final kindness; this alternative interprets renewed plans as public breakup management and participates by choosing the seating.
